description: This file defines the MinWordsUserTurnStartStrategy class, which implements a user turn start strategy based on a minimum number of spoken words, utilizing transcription frames and handling bot speaking states.

classes.name: MinWordsUserTurnStartStrategy
classes.description: Implements a user turn start strategy based on minimum spoken words, considering transcription frames and bot speaking status.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the strategy with minimum words and interim transcription usage options.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the internal state of the strategy.

methods.name: process_frame
methods.description: Processes incoming frames to determine if the user turn should start based on word count and bot speaking status.

methods.name: _handle_bot_started_speaking
methods.description: Handles frames indicating the bot has started speaking, updating internal state.

methods.name: _handle_bot_stopped_speaking
methods.description: Handles frames indicating the bot has stopped speaking, updating internal state.

methods.name: _handle_transcription
methods.description: Handles transcription frames to check if the minimum word count threshold is met to trigger user turn start.
